svg.text: Phase 2 enrichment, and the Phase 4 boundary — only what the player typed crosses
cover_ref cache path, never a URL
KEY violet = the game row (sheet 01) · gold = Phase 2 enrichment, every row stamped with fetched_at / observed_at · blue = Phase 4 server side · red = the only payload that crosses

state_change, comment and review key off game_uid — a stable, content-derived identity assigned in Phase 1. It is a merge HINT, not authoritative: ambiguous matches are shown to the player, never guessed.
NEVER crosses: the library itself, playtime, last_played_at, cover art, sinopse, prices — every one re-derivable on each device. And credentials. Ever.
ZERADO DATA MODEL - ENRICHMENT AND THE SYNC BOUNDARY

Phase 2 enrichment tables and the Phase 4 server side. state_change is the ONLY payload that crosses the sync boundary; the library itself is re-derivable on every device from the player's own sources.
